SOW_KEY()
For a message in a SOW topic, returns the current SOW key of the message. This will
typically be the AMPS-generated identifier for the message. For topics that use
explicit publisher-provided keys (that is, where the SOW key must be set on the
header of the publish command rather than derived from the data), this will be the
publisher-provided key.
This function is designed for use in enrichment. In a query, subscription, or delete
command, using the SowKeys header with the key or keys of interest is more
efficient.
Parameters
None.
Returns
The SOW key that AMPS uses for the message, either as provided by the publisher or
as used internally by AMPS, as a string.
Available For
Queries or enrichment of a SOW topic
Subscription to a SOW topic
